headline: IBF Extends Black Sea High-Risk Zone to Bulgarian and Romanian Coasts
summary: The International Bargaining Forum has extended the Black Sea high-risk maritime zone to cover areas off Bulgaria and Romania, under a decision adopted on November 18. Seafarers under IBF agreements gain additional entitlements, including a bonus.
why: The International Bargaining Forum sets pay and conditions for seafarers on many merchant vessels. Higher-risk classifications raise crew costs and can affect shipping insurance and freight rates.
